title: Confession and Parish
author: Bram Nystrom
blurb: Freya Eastwick, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
